title: SafeRoute-MAS: Coverage-Aware and Risk-Calibrated Message Routing for Multi-Agent Scientific Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13454v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce SafeRoute-MAS, a coverage-aware, risk-calibrated procedure that keeps all specialist messages or removes one using only pre-integration information. On a sealed cache of 5,328 committees, its source-compatible operating point gains +1.80 percentage points (95% CI [+1.13, +2.52]) while removing 12.76% of message tokens. We also run 4,580 controlled integrations over a stratified 458-committee sample on a public gpt-oss-120b endpoint. The sample estimate is -0.09 points; design weighting to the original workload gives +0.94 points (95% CI [-1.31, +3.50]) and 18.72% acted-input reduction. A weighted token-matched comparison likewise does not establish a selector advantage (+1.68 points, CI [-1.27, +5.10]). Only 13 of 88 cached non-neutral labels (14.8%) retain direction by repeated-call majority. translated_title: SafeRoute-MAS：面向多智能体科学推理的覆盖率感知与风险校准消息路由
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SafeRoute-MAS，一种覆盖率感知、风险校准的程序，它仅使用集成前的信息来决定保留所有专家消息还是移除其中一条。在一个包含5,328个委员会的密封缓存上，其与源兼容的工作点获得了+1.80个百分点的增益（95%置信区间[+1.13, +2.52]），同时移除了12.76%的消息令牌。我们还在公共gpt-oss-120b端点上，对一个458个委员会的分层样本进行了4,580次受控集成。样本估计值为-0.09个百分点；按原始工作负载进行设计加权后为+0.94个百分点（95%置信区间[-1.31, +3.50]），实际输入减少18.72%。加权的令牌匹配比较同样未能确立选择器的优势（+1.68个百分点，置信区间[-1.27, +5.10]）。88个缓存的非中性标签中仅有13个（14.8%）在重复调用多数投票下保持了方向一致性。加权后的预期损坏上置信限（UCL）为4.60%，但11个预设边际中仅有2个通过支持/风险规则。因此我们……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SafeRoute-MAS提出了一种仅利用集成前信息、覆盖率感知且风险校准的消息路由程序，在多智能体科学推理中通过选择性移除专家消息，在减少约12%–19%消息令牌的同时带来一定的准确率提升，但严格的统计验证显示其增益有限。
en_tdlr: SafeRoute-MAS introduces a coverage-aware, risk-calibrated message routing procedure that uses only pre-integration information to keep or remove specialist messages in multi-agent scientific reasoning, achieving modest accuracy gains while reducing message tokens by roughly 12–19%.
